scope: Architecture coverage and falsifiability only; no native or12-family acceptance

inventory.title: Bind pending changes and responsibility owners
inventory.scope: Separate committed source, index prototypes, working-only deltas and generated output; bind exact HEAD/path hashes and map every pending path to an existing owner
inventory.retire: No runtime retirement at this stage; eliminate ambiguous submission scope
inventory.validation: Stable read-only Git census; complete group coverage and acyclic typed stage links; no source/artifact mutation
inventory.benefit: Every candidate has a review boundary; published leaves cannot qualify the dirty working tree
inventory.excluded: Classification does not validate a hunk, ABI or runtime
inventory.modelDuty: Native SysML drives ASCENT coverage/dependency checks; no new behavioural QNT or Lean model

startup.title: Startup preparation and member publication
startup.scope: test8 actual setup/resize chain: rooted request, target resource census, concrete disjoint stack/heap grants, per-slot initialization, OS creation/entry gate and one member-publication authority
startup.retire: Count-only sufficiency followed by incidental section allocation; member publication before created native custody; rollback through an unrelated slot; pre-marker root receipt lost with a C activation
startup.validation: Original test8 must succeed unchanged in the existing profile; feasible grow/shrink/reuse, allocation/partial-create failure and unknown outcome keep exact source roots, grants and members; bootstrap and affected original GC/FFI consumers
startup.benefit: Requested topology has real backing before visibility; failure has one resource/root custodian, without changing min/max heap or waits
startup.excluded: Recoverable refusal alone is not test8 PASS. No full collector packing, all CFFI or universal join recovery in this cut. Earlier Heap-overflow diagnosis is not a fresh diagnosis of every exit70
startup.modelDuty: Reuse vm_resize_transaction.qnt for request/reserve/create/commit/unknown histories; RoundCapacity.lean owns conditional interval arithmetic only. Derive actual allocator bounds and source adapter; do not copy a finite capacity constant into C

roots.title: Close the complete frozen root population
roots.scope: Common globals prefix and admitted registry registration published7abe6770; remaining symbol/keyword publication, raw/cross-VM value writers, complete RootOrigin caller/lifetime census and relocation/reload
roots.retire: Per-scanner count authority retired7abe6770; next retire remaining unowned write/lifetime authority only after all selected callers migrate
roots.validation: Preserve actual common-prefix/C4-step replay and nonzero RC/map multi-shot roots; add the next selected source's late writer/failed transfer histories using existing PBT
roots.benefit: One frozen source population defines scan work and moving-cell updates
roots.excluded: Named root tasks alone are not total census, independent workers or arbitrary raw FFI coverage
roots.modelDuty: Existing root-dispatch QNT owns task histories; existing root coverage laws own distinct conditional cell/partition arithmetic; source completeness remains source evidence

workers.title: Worker arenas, unique copy work and context restoration
workers.scope: W workers consume R frozen root domains; worker owns copy/scan/Tail and contiguous grants; each context receives its restoration space and owner-affine cleanup independently
workers.retire: Collector cursors, refill and restoration inferred from carrier indexes; unowned claimed/private work
workers.validation: W<R, exact moving roots, forwarding/CAS loss, claimed chunks/Tail, restore all R contexts, partial failure and original topology; same heap policy and measured physical peak
workers.benefit: Useful collector work need not equal execution carrier population; no hidden work disappears at an idle decrement
workers.excluded: Changing worker counts alone, larger heap or extra checks do not qualify this stage
workers.modelDuty: Existing work/copy QNT models own histories; existing accounting/packing Lean laws own conditional bounds. Full C producer census, C23 ordering and physical layout remain explicit refinements

scheduling.title: Request ownership, wait state and service activation
scheduling.scope: One request ownership chain through publish/claim/execute/result/abandonment; durable runnable/park handoff; waiting state and service activation retain distinct roots and outcomes
scheduling.retire: Processor routing treated as semantic request ownership; wake treated as completion; repeated state rebuilding only where actual source/cost evidence permits
scheduling.validation: Real mailbox/migration/block/GC and exception/multi-shot histories, PBT replay/shrink, native wait failure and original pressure; per-target progress and actual allocation/materialization attribution
scheduling.benefit: Remove redundant routing/capture/retention work while preserving synchronous Scheme result and supported control semantics
scheduling.excluded: repair9 is one failure corpus, not the programme. No deletion of catchers absent from this branch; no pooling/coalescing arbitrary thunks or one-shot restriction on user continuations
scheduling.modelDuty: Reuse existing delivery/wait temporal models; source/effect/GC map equivalence and native cost are separate. No duplicate Lean temporal machine

entries.title: Generated entry and acquired-effect exit custody
entries.scope: Root before marker/conversion allocation, writer permits, callback origin, nonlocal escape and exactly matched physical cleanup for selected real callers
entries.retire: Parallel native_scope naming and manual entry/root/cleanup authority only after every selected consumer migrates
entries.validation: Both run origins, actual SFUN/CFUN generator paths, nested callbacks and exceptional/nonlocal cleanup with moving roots; official embedding/FFI tests
entries.benefit: Generated contracts cover hidden collecting calls and acquired effects, preserving C portability
entries.excluded: Do not fold every Tcl/service redesign into a root or startup REV; unknown native writes retain explicit restrictions
entries.modelDuty: Existing host-root/unwind models retain distinct protocol and acquired-effect duties; source caller completeness and native execution cannot be replaced by model references

retirement.title: Participant removal and resource-specific retirement
retirement.scope: Execution exit, GC participation, native return, pending work and final resource reclamation have separate completion owners; unknown join isolates one VM while healthy VM still collects
retirement.retire: Global reclaim inferred from one VM, ignored join status and destructive reset of still-owned state
retirement.validation: Actual partial creation/join failure/unknown result, late callbacks/producers, repeated setup/cleanup and healthy-VM GC; no forced zero counters
retirement.benefit: Failures preserve one legal custodian without making all VM GC depend on an unresolved owner
retirement.excluded: No safe takeover without physical writer closure/stop evidence; quarantine is not successful reclamation
retirement.modelDuty: Reuse existing retirement/unknown-outcome protocols and separate conditional ownership accounting laws; native stop/join and callback affinity need their own observations

generations.title: Generational allocation and remembered roots
generations.scope: Young allocation, promotion reserve, noncollecting barriers, continuation/denv/FFI remembered writes and a sound major/fallback path
generations.retire: Repeated mature graph traversal only for writer-complete admitted classes
generations.validation: Promotion/overflow/failure/epoch handoff, true writers and multi-shot shared frames; saved scanning versus barrier, copying and peak costs on one producer
generations.benefit: Skip proven unchanged mature work while preserving shared Scheme semantics
generations.excluded: Copying is not generational collection. No OCaml algorithm copy or assumed speedup; a later algorithm invalidates affected acceptance
generations.modelDuty: Existing generational QNT owns store/epoch/failure histories; conditional root/packing laws remain distinct from actual writer census

qualification.title: Same-source whole-runtime acceptance
qualification.scope: Bind complete branch-specific GSI/GSC, additional PR, stress, registry, rollback, GC/FFI, Gerbil and release-cost inventories to the final selected source/profile/limits
qualification.retire: Cross-credit from old repair images, a focused PBT suite or one local REV
qualification.validation: All required actual cases/markers, original populations, natural exits and same-producer receipts; remote CI separately observed
qualification.benefit: A reproducible whole-runtime decision instead of a misleading local-REV numerator
qualification.excluded: repair8/12 is not this branch. Generational changes require new affected qualification even after an earlier stable SMP baseline
qualification.modelDuty: SysML routes scope/needs to ASCENT; QNT/Lean retain their algorithm-specific duties and cannot certify native performance or missing inventories

generated.disposition: Producer-derived output; bind generating Scheme/features/compiler and affected ABI before selecting. Never hand-edit or bulk publish mixed profiles.

headers.disposition: Separate byte-preserving header extraction from context/worker/layout semantics and C23 admission. Any ABI-changing hunk needs all real layout consumers in one buildable cut.

build.disposition: Support current required source closure using existing Bazel/configure/Make; keep unrelated cleanup, phase and frontend tuning parked. Do not introduce another profile/executor.

membership.disposition: Select startup preparation/publication subset first; broader registry/cleanup/unknown join stays a separate later responsibility. A path includes multiple cuts.

collector.disposition: Separate source-coordinate noise, root census, startup grants, copy ownership and independent arenas. Existing unqualified prototype is not a tested successor.

entryChanges.disposition: Distinguish writer-authority rename from semantic entry/root/exception changes. Only startup-required entry effects belong in the next cut; broad CFFI/Tcl remains separate.

scheduleChanges.disposition: Published mutex cut is not these remaining hunks. Separate FIFO/mailbox/atomic publication from future wait/service architecture and measure real source costs first.

testChanges.disposition: Tests accompany their actual implementation owner; preserve official cases and failure evidence. Index deletion plus same-name untracked file requires explicit custody, not bulk staging.

ciChanges.disposition: Gambit repository only; publish after required implementation/source distribution and actual tests qualify. Preserve official Build/Test commands and remote-state distinction.

foundationClosure.factor: Repair-line test8/test9 pass is reference evidence; modern-c must own correct embedding startup and original GC/dynamic-module consumers
foundationClosure.replacement: Rooted request, complete physical grants, initialized/created slots and single member commit replace incidental allocation and count-before-create
foundationClosure.premise: Every origin root survives GC; grants are disjoint actual intervals; abort refunds only known joined actors
foundationClosure.falsifier: One unrooted losing resize request, overlapping pair, child entering after ABORT, or successful membership without a real child
foundationClosure.acceptance: Unchanged official test8 and test9 on the selected source/profile; root reload, partial create, metadata failure, unknown join and rollback controls
foundationClosure.saving: Remove repeated per-slot sufficiency guesses and fatal partial startup; no claimed repair9 throughput gain
foundationClosure.overhead: One bounded VM ledger/gate plus traced request/child cells and derived physical resume allowance

rootClosure.factor: The independent-globals-count factor is retired7abe6770; remaining carrier/raw sources and shared-table writers still prevent a total moving-root census
rootClosure.replacement: Published shared globals prefix/registration plus RootOrigin source/lifetime and RootTask scan/completion for every remaining selected source
rootClosure.premise: Complete producer/writer/alias census, stable revision independent of GC address, write closure and post-GC reload
rootClosure.falsifier: A legal writer or borrowed cell omitted from census, different shard counts, relocation treated as logical mutation, or duplicate scan ownership
rootClosure.acceptance: Keep7abe shared-prefix, physical-capacity and actual C4-step replay; add remaining nonzero/alias/value-writer and failed-transfer histories on exact C
rootClosure.saving: One source census and unique task responsibility; avoid redundant scans only where source uniqueness is proved
rootClosure.overhead: Published registry/permanent gates and snapshot records are quantified in globals-snapshot-result.org; remaining freeze/claim/revision and retained-failure costs require their own measurements

workerClosure.factor: Execution-carrier identity currently couples GC root ownership, private copy/scan work and restoration space
workerClosure.replacement: W WorkerArenas consume R RootTasks; unique copy/Tail custody and separate R restoration grants replace carrier-index inference
workerClosure.premise: Complete pre-copy source/frame bound, contiguous placement and all hidden producers/claimed chunks covered through close
workerClosure.falsifier: Forwarding visible without initialized-copy custodian, missed Tail/claimed chunk, lost CAS grant or one unrestored context when W<R
workerClosure.acceptance: Actual W<R and W=R histories, multi-shot map/GC, native capacity/failure controls and original stress with unchanged resource limits
workerClosure.saving: No duplicate destination reservation, independent collector scheduling and less unnecessary worker participation when justified
workerClosure.overhead: Explicit work records, physical packing/restore planning and synchronization; no assumed speedup

serviceClosure.factor: Repair9 crosses request ownership, target lifetime, wait/service control, continuation retention and collective GC; focused reply success does not establish original-load capacity
serviceClosure.replacement: One publish/claim/execute/result-or-abandon owner chain, durable runnable/park handshake, waiting-state roots separate from request service activation
serviceClosure.premise: Exactly-once invocation/outcome under supported migration and nonlocal control; unchanged multi-shot Scheme continuation and dynamic-wind semantics
serviceClosure.falsifier: Inactive target acknowledged as serviced, lost runnable notification, double execution/result, control suffix omitted, or stable backlog with growing retained graph
serviceClosure.acceptance: Real request/migration/interrupt/GC PBT and shrink; original interpreted and compiled stress with per-target counts, natural exits and source-bound cost attribution
serviceClosure.saving: Retire duplicate routing and unnecessary private capture/materialization only where present in modern-c; preserve user captures
serviceClosure.overhead: Authoritative request/outcome state and queue synchronization; accepted backlog still consumes real memory and service

exitClosure.factor: A zero counter, native return or failed join is not proof that roots, callbacks and descendant cleanup have no remaining user
exitClosure.replacement: Per-resource completion/last-user custody and VM-local unknown isolation replace monolithic destructive cleanup
exitClosure.premise: Physical writer closure, known actor identity, all resource readers/producers and owner-affine effects discharged or transferred
exitClosure.falsifier: Late callback writes reclaimed state, cleanup waits on its own GC participant, unknown join storage reused, or unrelated healthy VM cannot collect
exitClosure.acceptance: Actual late callback/partial failure/unknown join, healthy-VM GC, repeated setup/cleanup and original lifecycle inventory
exitClosure.saving: Remove global failure coupling and retention without a resource owner; successful reclamation still requires real reconciliation
exitClosure.overhead: Resource custody records, delayed release and bounded-admission refusal; unknown retention is not a memory saving

wholeClosure.factor: Repair9 label, official test9 and ordinal acceptance9 are different identities; old8/12 and local REVs cannot be added
wholeClosure.replacement: One final source/profile/inventory/limit identity composes architecture contracts and all actual acceptance receipts
wholeClosure.premise: All applicable source refinements closed, mandatory native cases natural-complete, failures retained, release evidence matched
wholeClosure.falsifier: Any stale generated/header/native product, omitted mandatory test, changed population/cap, unresolved lifecycle error or performance regression
wholeClosure.acceptance: Twelve existing named families: complete GSI/GSC/PR/stress, registry, faults, GC/FFI, Gerbil and release; remote CI observed separately
wholeClosure.saving: Reproducible claims, precise reuse and auditable incremental progress; no invented speedup or9-12 guarantee
wholeClosure.overhead: Real whole-inventory and matched cost qualification after each affected architectural change

policy.policy: Modern C reconstruction is the programme. Repair9 and test8 are evidence/acceptance inputs, not the architecture or a progress numerator. Plan stages group responsibility cuts and may require multiple independently qualified REVs. A matching file is not a staging unit. No runtime/native acceptance follows from this plan.
policy.immediate: Globals registry-prefix/snapshot responsibility is published as7abe6770 after five gates/21 controls,392 native PBT actions, a real C20-to4-step counterexample/current replay and full original GSI/Make, preserving ff44 startup/test8/test9. The common count authority and two registry append producers are closed within that scope. Next inspect symbol/keyword publication, remaining value writers and caller/lifetime census; independent workers and Repair9 remain later dependency-bound work. Preserve unrelated prototypes; do not revert, bulk stage or transplant repair patches.
policy.commitRule: A bounded REV needs exact source/ABI consumers, actual required tests, learning/benefit/cost, process and model/question closure under shared five ASCENT gates. Missing tests or unexplained affected failures block it. Broader failures must have explicit applicability/disposition; scoped gate readiness never means whole branch admission.
policy.nextSource: Use7abe6770 as the admitted common-globals-prefix foundation. Trace symbol/keyword table anchors, interning, explicit cross-VM value stores and remaining raw/native callers to actual write/borrow/exit owners. Select the next complete source-publication responsibility before independent worker dispatch. Existing root-entry leaves, the common snapshot and startup custody are not a total census or arbitrary FFI admission.
policy.nextAcceptance: Retain the shared-prefix and actual C4-step replay, physical20000-slot refusal, p1/p2 moving roots, map multi-shot and ff44 startup/test8/test9/early-root-drain controls. The next selected writer/source adapter needs actual accepted/refused publication, relocated-cell and failed-transfer histories through existing PBT. Every old reader must have a lifetime owner; raw writer exclusion and total census must not be inferred from a RootTask name or a stable count.
policy.nextExclusions: The next root publication/writer cut does not include all collector arenas/packing, every unknown join, global CFFI/Tcl redesign, entire header extraction, cleanup policy, frontend macro tuning or request-service optimization. Include only transitively necessary helpers and consumers. No heap/wait increase, official interface rename, inherited repair count or bulk promotion of pending source.
policy.supportPolicy: Header modularization, C23/toolchain admission, generated products/build invalidation and vendor CI remain separate support lanes. They join a runtime REV only for its actual source/ABI dependency closure. Preserve existing Bazel/configure/Make and official test names. A mechanically moved header must prove losslessness independently from semantic field changes; generated C must bind one source/features/compiler cohort; CI follows qualified source/tests.
policy.closurePolicy: Official test8/test9 are known repaired behavior on the repair line, not Repair9 or acceptance families8/9. Reconstruct and qualify the foundation on modern-c before the coupled Repair9 work. A checklist is a falsifiable architecture-coverage argument: source mechanism retired, owning contract, dependency, counterexample and native acceptance; it is never a claim that planning or finite model success already solves9-12. Whole acceptance is the conjunction on one final source, not the sum of local REVs.
policy.capacityPolicy: Repair9 correctness and capacity are separate: at minimum count accepted/claimed/completed/abandoned work, live request roots, captured versus materialized frames, copied/scanned bytes, waiting/service time and retained peak. Finite safety cannot prove a deadline. Unbounded arrival or an indefinitely retained user multi-shot continuation precludes a universal constant-memory/latency claim. No pooling or one-shot restriction is imposed to manufacture a gain.
